mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle, increasing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and compressing future stock valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the CPIAUCSL index above 3.0% triggers inflation concerns, prompting risk aversion and reduced market valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDPC1 (demand growth) and decrease in FEDFUNDS (easing) lowers discount rates, enhancing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when the easing and demand growth co-occur, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high INDPRO (supply growth) and low UNRATE (labor tightness) indicate a late-cycle expansion, fostering optimism and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during late-cycle regimes, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained UNRATE below 3.0% reflects a strong labor market, boosting investor confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE remains below 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of HOUST above 1500 units signals heightened demand, elevating market sentiment and resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST crosses above 1500, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising RSAFS (demand growth) alongside decreasing FEDFUNDS (easing) lowers discount rates, improving equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when the easing and demand growth co-occur, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained FEDFUNDS above 2.5% for three months signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS remains above 2.5% for three months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
